scope: Three test-only paths: actual loopback HTTPS receiver for the existing first WEB cross-site rendered case; other nine F3 cases retain virtual origins.

priorActualFailure.target: Real source POST303 redirected GET bypasses Playwright page.route and reaches DNS for the virtual ERP hostname. Existing Strict/Lax, locator, password and consent steps passed before that transport failure.

changes: Ephemeral Node HTTPS listener bound only to127.0.0.1 with exact method/Host/return target and bounded generation/request/shutdown timeouts.
Installed OpenSSL generates a private temporary self-signed certificate; private PEM files are removed before the receiver is returned and buffers are cleared after TLS context creation.
Only the first WEB case overrides the ERP origin and ignores certificate errors inside an unnamed Playwright describe; the real source303 and all existing browser assertions remain.
Return-cookie assertions inspect immutable snapshots of headers actually received by the HTTPS listener; no browser Cookie forwarding or manual navigation is introduced.
Four Node HTTPS helper cases validate transport/target/cleanup and do not claim browser cookie or MFA acceptance.
